# Workspace Instructions

At the beginning of every task in this workspace, read the repository-root `brain.md` before answering or editing. Use it as project orientation, then verify relevant facts in the current source files and configuration; do not treat it as a replacement for code inspection.

Before changing code, identify the owning CAP service or UI5 application and check for current user edits. Keep changes focused, follow the repository conventions, and validate with the narrowest useful build, lint, or test command. Do not modify generated artifacts or production credentials unless the user explicitly requests it.
